title: Glass slider, petal icon and tinted pane fan
summary: A refractive glass track slides under a fixed call knob over deep blue waves, a hard cut to a pastel petal icon pulling out and turning, then one lilac glass pane splits into a three-pane fan that rotates and merges back.
use_when: Showing off a translucent glass material or a new visual style for a UI kit
A short silent loop for a feed where the material is the message
Teasing a call, unlock or confirm control before the full product film
An app icon refresh where the icon itself can carry a shot

look.type_style: regular grotesk, lowercase, normal tracking, ~6 % of frame height, white at ~70 % opacity inside the track

sfx.event: glass track slides under the knob
hard cut to the petal icon
fan merges back into one pane

structure.shot: white call knob at centre, glass track to its right with a clipped 3-word instruction, blue wave backdrop
glass track slides left under the fixed knob; leading cap stretches with a rainbow fringe; label scrolls
structure.camera: locked on the knob; backdrop drifts with the track (motion.json pan 19 to 49 px/s @1920, zoom within ±3.3 %/s)
structure.motion: track travel ~95 % of frame width over 75 fr, easings.inOutCubic (±0.25 s); cap stretch peaks at 1.77-2.00 then relaxes, springs.ui (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: the track rests with the knob at its right cap; the last word of the label sits to the left of the knob
structure.motion: settle hold 24 fr; right cap stops within 5 px of its final x by 3.50 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: close-up of a white icon tile with overlapping pastel petals; pulls out and turns until the tile fits, then leaves
structure.camera: pull-out: tile width ~3.0x to ~1.0x of its final size over 119 fr (motion.json zoom -36 to -20 %/s), rotation ~17-22 deg/s, easings.outQuint (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: petals overlap with multiply-like tint; tile gone between 8.27 and 8.50 (exit ≤ 7 fr, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: empty mint backdrop, then one lilac glass rounded-rectangle pane at centre, face-on, about 35 % of frame width
structure.motion: pane appears between 8.50 and 8.77 (≤ 8 fr), springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); at 9.27 a second edge shows as it starts to turn

structure.shot: the pane turns ~30 deg about its vertical axis and splits into three stepped panes: lilac front, rose middle, mint back
structure.motion: split and turn complete by 9.50 (≤ 8 fr), springs.ui (±0.25 s); fan holds 30 fr with a slow drift of ~2 % width

structure.shot: the three-pane fan flips through the horizontal to the mirrored side; mint now on the left, lilac on the right
structure.motion: flip from 10.50 to 11.27 (~23 fr), easings.inOutCubic (±0.25 s); holds 22 fr; at 12.00 starts the reverse turn

structure.shot: the panes swing back and collapse into the single lilac pane at centre, which fades out on mint
structure.motion: merge done by 12.50 (≤ 8 fr), springs.ui (±0.25 s); hold 8 fr; fade to ~10 % by 13.00, easings.inQuad (±0.25 s)

params.content.label: slider instruction inside the track, 3 words, lowercase
params.content.knobGlyph: glyph in the knob (default a call handset, LineGlyph phone)
params.content.icon: app icon or mark for the pull-out row (default petal cluster on a white tile)
params.content.paneColors: three pane tints, front to back (default lilac, rose, mint)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with fps/30

notes: Silent reference: no music, no beats, cut_on_beat 0/1 (no beats to match). SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. All entrance and settle frames measured at 0.25 s resolution from sheets; no 30 fps strip was extracted. The knob stays fixed at frame centre while the track moves, which is what sells the slide. Glass needs real refraction and a chromatic fringe on the moving cap (WebGL transmission material), hence hard/heavy. Row 4 beat chosen as reveal (icon treated as product, not brand mark). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): glass-slider, pane-fan, object-flip.
